description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with Effect from 05.02.2024  to 11.02.2024
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, which is a regulatory matter. The content involves setting and modifying legal requirements for financial calculations in international trade, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
